title: Street spiritual singers and church
summary: Morris saw few street singers of spirituals; he is Catholic and heard no music in church as a boy.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Do you remember many of the guitar players that played sacred songs, spirituals like Blind Willie Johnson? He worked on the streets and all sometimes. I think he was here a while. Any of those singers from the churches that...
North of the world. You mean like singing to them spirituality churches?
Yeah. Sometimes even on the street, take their guitar out on the street and sing.
Well, I hardly see maybe about two, three of them on the street and sing, but I don't know.
What church were you a member of?
What church were you a member of?
Member? Uh-huh. Well, this religion that I follow is Catholic, but any of the churches do me good now. Uh-huh.
You were brought up, born a Catholic?
I see. I just thought maybe you had heard some music in church when you were young, that impression.
No, well, not in church, no.
